# Erdos.p932 — Erdős problem 932

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/932
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/932.lean`, theorem `erdos_932`, AMS 11).

Let $p_k$ denote the $k$th prime. For infinitely many $r$ there are at least two
integers $p_r < n < p_{r+1}$ all of whose prime factors are $< p_{r + 1} - p_r$.

## Statement
{ r : ℕ | 2 ≤ (Finset.Ioo (r.nth Nat.Prime) (r.succ.nth Nat.Prime) |>.filter
      (fun m => m.maxPrimeFac < r.succ.nth Nat.Prime - r.nth Nat.Prime)).card }.Infinite

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
